integrity: The closed-form survival functions were independently compared with a full 15-state infected-subset generator by exact rational derivative identities, characteristic-polynomial uniqueness, and polynomial sign arguments; no independent external audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed seven-vertex complete bipartite graph, exactly three perfect permanent sentinels, one uniformly chosen SI seed, independent equal positive exponential per-edge transmission and no recovery. General graph and other epidemic models are not asserted; historical priority is provisional.
title: A sharp deadline-driven reversal of epidemic sentinel placement on \(K_{3,4}\)
